grammar.title: Negative comparison with 没有
grammar.pattern: A + 没有 + B + (这么/那么) + 形容词
grammar.explanation: 没有 (méiyǒu) can make a comparison negative — "A is not as [adjective] as B". It's a common alternative to 不比, often paired with 这么 or 那么 before the adjective.

grammar.title: Suddenly with 突然
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 突然 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 突然 (tūrán) describes something happening suddenly, without warning. It can go before the subject or right before the verb, and often appears with 了 to mark a sudden change.

sentences.pinyin: Dàyǔ zàochéng le hěn duō wèntí.
sentences.en: The heavy rain caused a lot of problems.
